reason: Two thousand dollars just to get started, before I know if it catches even one job I'd have missed, is a lot to put down on a phone answering thing. The monthly I could live with, but I'm not paying the setup this month on a first look.
objection: I don't actually know how many calls I miss. If it's two a month, I'm paying 2,000 $ plus 249 $ a month for something my voicemail mostly does already.
would_change_my_mind: If the setup was waived or refunded when it doesn't bring me at least one real job in the first two months, I'd try it.
